# Full Tri-Language Harmony: Court, Liturgical, and Capital Market languages align
oe_cul2_trilingual_harmony = {
	potential_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		court_language ?= liturgical_language
		capital ?= {
			market ?= {
				language ?= root.court_language
			}
		}
	}
	legislative_efficiency = 0.05
	cultural_influence_modifier = 0.10
	global_integration_speed_modifier = 0.08
	change_court_language_cost_modifier = -0.15
}

# Court-Liturgical Concord: Court and Liturgical languages align even in a cosmopolitan market
oe_cul2_dual_court_liturgy_harmony = {
	potential_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		court_language ?= liturgical_language
		NOT = {
			capital ?= {
				market ?= {
					language ?= root.court_language
				}
			}
		}
	}
	legislative_efficiency = 0.03
	cultural_tradition_modifier = 0.06
	global_monthly_literacy = 0.02
}

# Bilingual Imperial Chancellery: Active multinational state apparatus (real court-spending tradeoff)
oe_cul2_bilingual_imperial_chancellery = {
	potential_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_variable = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_on
		any_accepted_culture = {
			count >= 3

		OR = {
			has_policy = oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism

		}
	}
	accepted_culture_maintenance_cost_modifier = -0.25
